messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGE: Inference pool eu-west-3 reporting multiple NotReady nodes and kubelet restarts. 20% capacity loss on p-infer-euw3. Alerts: pod restarts, 5xx spike for streaming endpoints. Pager: @Sam oncall
Mira: acked. I'm pulling logs and checking autoscaler. Can someone confirm recent infra changes in eu-west-3?
Sam: oncall here, saw the page. Jumping in. No recent model rollouts. Quick check: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-euw3 -o wide` shows a few nodes NotReady.
Anya: past 30m we pushed a kernel/security kubelet minor bump to the eu-west auto-rolling group (staggered). I didn't see failures in canary.
Rolf: that rollout started ~45m ago. We paused after the canary, but some hosts still got the update due to drift. Could be kubelet/driver ABI mismatch.
Mira: prioritize: 1) triage customer impact; 2) stop rolling updates to avoid more flaps; 3) steer traffic to dedicated capacity and scale autoscaler.
Sam: customer impact: Support-Triage, any active customer escalations?
Support-Triage: seeing 12 customer reports in the last 20m, mostly 502/timeout on streaming generation. Severity: P2 for a subset of high-throughput customers. We've sent initial status page blurb.
Mira: ok — mitigation plan: cordon unhealthy nodes, drain safe ones, scale up dedicated pool and set routing policy to prefer reserved capacity for high-priority tenants, enable degrade-to-quantized-model fallback for background jobs.
Rolf: halting the kernel rollouts now. Patch-group paused. I'll add a cluster-suspend tag.
Anya: grabbing kubelet logs from one NotReady node. log snippet:
```
Mar 15 13:12:04 ip-10-0-2-45 kubelet[2345]: E0315 13:12:04.123456 kubelet.go:234] runtime service not ready: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
Mar 15 13:12:06 ip-10-0-2-45 kernel: [ 4321.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, GPU page fault, reason: ECC error
Mar 15 13:12:07 ip-10-0-2-45 containerd: container "srv-infer-abc" OOMKilled
Mar 15 13:12:08 ip-10-0-2-45 systemd: kubelet.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```
Mira: that looks like a GPU driver/oom interplay causing kubelet to crash. We should avoid mass restarts that reintroduce the driver state until infra confirms driver compatibility.
Sam: executing mitigation commands now. Steps: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-2-45.eu-west-3` then `kubectl drain ip-10-0-2-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` for nodes that can be safely drained.
Anya: running drain on 3/5 affected nodes. One node is flapping and can't be drained (kubelet not responding).
Mira: for flapping node, we need a hard reset at the provider level. Rolf, can you trigger instance reset and hold it out of rotation?
Rolf: doing a hard reset and adding `maintenance:quarantined` label. Also disabling auto-roll for that host. Command I'm running: `gcloud compute instances reset ip-10-0-2-45 --zone=europe-west3-b && kubectl label node ip-10-0-2-45 maintenance=quarantined`
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline paused for kernel-rollout-job-2026-03-15.
Sam: routing change in progress: increasing dedicated pool capacity by +30% and toggling routing policy to prefer dedicated for tenants tagged priority=gold. Running `rbacctl scale cluster-dedicated-euw3 --replicas=13` and updating routing weights.
Mira: also enable cache warmup on dedicated nodes to reduce cold-start latency: `infra-tool warmup --pool dedicated-euw3 --paths /kvcache/prefixes`.
Anya: I captured container logs for the OOMKilled serving container. snippet:
```
[stream] tokenizers loaded
[model] loading weights part-03.bin
MemoryError: mmap failed: Cannot allocate memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/serving/worker.py", line 142, in init_model
    weights = mmap.load(path)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.10/mmap.py", line 225, in load
    raise MemoryError
```
Possible runaway memory allocation during model init after partial driver reset.
Sam: for immediate relief, rolling restart of the inference deployment with reduced workers per pod to lower per-pod memory usage: `kubectl set env deploy/infer-srv WORKERS=2` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-srv -n p-infer` (targeted to euw3 via nodeSelector).
Mira: good. Also add temporary autoscaler override to be more aggressive: `kubectl patch hpa infer-srv-hpa -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 10}}'`
Rolf: reset completed on the flapping host. kubelet is coming back but with a warning: driver module failed to load initially. I'm pulling dmesg and contacting cloud GPU support.
Anya: we've routed ~85% of traffic off the affected nodes. 502 rate decreased from 6% -> 0.7% for most customers. High-priority tenants now at <1% error.
Support-Triage: posting updated note to customers: "We experienced degraded inference availability in eu-west-3; mitigation is underway and traffic has been shifted to reserved capacity. Expect intermittent streaming timeouts to reduce over next 30 minutes."
Mira: logging next actions: 1) infra to confirm driver/kernel compatibility and produce a rollback plan for the kernel-kubelet minor bump; 2) SRE to run evict+quarantine sweep and reason about OOM root cause; 3) DevEx to audit model memory pinning and init sequence.
Rolf: opening infra ticket INFRA-2398 for driver/kernel regression and tagging with high priority.
Sam: I'm taking post-incident owner. I'll run a blameless timeline and include command outputs. Handoff to night oncall at +1h if stable.
Mira: thanks team. If errors resurface, alert me @Mira immediately.
Anya: leaving a short note for follow-up: check nvml logs and containerd runtime mem limits, maybe bump pod memory requests for critical routes.
deploy-bot: kernel-rollout-job-2026-03-15: cancelled by Rolf.
Support-Triage: updating tickets and marking 6 customers as impacted; CS will coordinate crediting per policy.
Sam: last check: 502s trending down in the dashboard, gpu driver ticket created, nodes quarantined. Moving this to monitoring-only; handoff in 30m unless new alerts.
Mira: handoff acknowledged. Good triage and quick steering. We'll draft an incident postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps.
Support-Triage: adding a short customer-facing summary for readiness later.
Sam: final note before handoff: incident channel + pager escalations remain active for 45m. I'll capture logs to /incidents/2415000000/ and assign follow-ups.
Mira: thanks — closing active coordination.
